title: Security & Access Control

introduction.title: PEGA Security Architecture
introduction.text: Security is fundamental to enterprise applications. PEGA provides comprehensive security features including authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and data protection mechanisms that ensure applications meet enterprise security requirements and compliance standards.

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: PEGA provides comprehensive security features for enterprise applications
Multiple authentication mechanisms support various enterprise integration scenarios
Role-based access control enables granular permission management
Data security mechanisms protect sensitive information through encryption and access controls
Security patterns like defense in depth and secure by design ensure robust protection
Audit and compliance capabilities support regulatory requirements
Comprehensive security testing validates protection mechanisms
Following security best practices ensures robust and compliant applications
